notes_for_editor: Two sources only; neither gives a construction year or a removal year, so the story gives none. No Forest Fire Lookout Association or national register entry for this butte turned up in the cache or in search. Firelookout.com names the Umatilla National Forest; the Oregon Lookouts list says only National Forest, so the story uses the fuller name. The record's point (44.83764, -119.58722) has not been checked against firelookout.com's 'about 8 miles west of Monument'; a human could check the coordinates against the survey location 8S-26E-35. Web searches used: 2. Pages read: the two source pages.
